build_speech_to_text_head_selection_task: build a fairseq task that performs speech-to-text with attention head selection for language or domain tasks
create_map_task_to_id: create a mapping from source language, target language, and domain names to integer IDs for training subsets
run_train_step_with_kl_loss: run a training step that computes criterion loss plus KL divergence loss for encoder and decoder attention head selection
load_dataset_with_domain: load a speech-to-text dataset with domain metadata from TSV files using language and domain mappings
run_inference_step: run inference on speech-to-text samples by setting task IDs on encoder and decoder before generating output
